verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs describe Templates as saved, reusable page layouts that form the base for every new Object you create, which covers defining templates and applying them to recurring kinds of notes (they can also carry cover images). Nothing in the evidence shows template variables such as auto-filled date or title, a material part of the story. missing for 10: template variables (date/title substitution), detail on how a template is chosen or applied per Type, independent or hands-on corroboration.
